title: Android: Showing duplicate node key after recent update
body:
### What is the issue?

Admin Console shows Duplicate Node key on Phone device. 
Suspected issue with unused FireTV device. Removed. No Change.
Removed Android phone (Pixel 7 Pro) from tailnet. Uninstalled app. Reinstalled. Connected to tailnet. Connects fine, about 5 seconds later Admin Console shows "Duplicate Node key" again.
Repeated Uninstall, reinstall. Same results.

No other Android based devices on Tailnet.

No other device on tailnet shows same error.

This device has never been cloned.

### Steps to reproduce

Install most recent version with Taildrop support on Android 15 device. Error should appear within 10 seconds.

### Are there any recent changes that introduced the issue?

This is the update that added Taildrop to Android and prompts to select a folder for Taildrop at install.

### OS

Android

### OS version

15

### Tailscale version

1.84.1

### Other software

Proton VPN is installed, but not running while Tailscale is.

### Bug report

BUG-6453cb5353654fffe67f00eb9f5006c0a22b3ebb17f3c9dba1b40bb32ff1cb1a-20250624171444Z-3c8523d4dcac81e8

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
I can confirm. I've a phone and a tablet now. Here's my timeline:

1. Installed TS on phone when it was still Android 14.
2. Upgraded phone to Android 15.
3. No issues.
4. Got a new tablet and cloned the phone settings. ❗ 
5. Installed TS on tablet with Android 15.
6. I get "Duplicate node key" on admin panel. Most likely because of the cloned settings, keys.
7. Reinstalled TS on BOTH devices as per [the documentation troubleshooting](https://tailscale.com/kb/1023/troubleshooting?q=%22Duplicate+node+key%22#multiple-devices-have-the-same-100x-ip-address).
8. Now I get "Duplicate node key" on both of them.

Looking at the "Node key" attribute for both devices, they are not the same.

Could it be that the cloning of the phone's key messed things up? 🤔

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
In my case I have never cloned my device or its settings. So I don't know what is going on.  It doesn't seem to affect functionality as far as I can tell.  
Up until the recent update the app had issues with communicating with the coordination server.  It would randomly lose connection with coordination server about once every 4-8 hours (seat of the pants estimate, I haven't actually measured it).  And it was almost guaranteed to do so when navigating a transition between a cellular and Wi-Fi signal.

In fact I just checked and the app is now showing "Health warnings: Out of sync: Unable to connect to the Tailscale coordination server to synchronize the state of your tailnet.  Peer reachability might degrade over time." (Currently on work Wi-Fi) This has been a common error as well. But it still shows as connected in the Admin Console. I can usually temporarily fix that particular error by disconnecting, closing the app, then reopening and connecting again.  This time I am getting a new error upon reconnect "DNS unavailable: Tailscale can't reach the configured DNS servers. Internet connectivity may be affected."

Okay. I might have inadvertently fixed the "Duplicate Node Key" issue while trying to fix the most recent app error. I did the following:

Turned off wifi.
Disconnected.
Closed app.
Phone was still showing an active VPN in top right, so I went to VPN setting in the phone and pressed forget VPN.
Reopened app.
Connected again.  Phone asked if I wanted to add a VPN as if I had just installed the Tailscale app. Pressed yes (or add whichever it was).
Phone reconnected with no errors.
Admin console now, no longer show the Duplicate Node Key.
This condition has now persisted for at least the last 5-7 minutes.

If everything holds as is for a couple of hours, I'll notify.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
So the Duplicate Node Key issue has not reappeared in over 20 hours. So I'll consider that issue fixed. Why it happened in the first place is a mystery.  Best I can tell after the update the app attempted to reprovision the node key, resulting in the coordination server interpreting it as two devices attempting to use the same key.  A developer will need to look into this.

The other issues regarding degrading connection with the coordination server over time is more of an annoyance than anything. I'm curious if it has something to do with the way that Pixel phones on Google Fi (which is my carrier) constantly look for and transition to the strongest signal regardless of network carrier.  Around here Google Fi can use T-Mobile and US Cellular.  Add in trying to maintain a VPN connection, and transition between Wi-Fi and cellular signals results in a lost connection. Again a developer will better insight here.

For those that reinstalling didn't work: Check to make sure that the VPN connection is closed.  
That was the issue I ran into. Even after closing the app the VPN connection to the tailnet was still in place. I had to go into the VPN settings, Press the Gear icon, then select Forget VPN. Only then did the Duplicate Node Key warning close.

I installed just yesterday TS and  i have the same issue: The web admin console shows the device with a “duplicate node key” error after about 1 minutes after connection. I noticed this happens when i simply try to browse internet.
Steps already tried (none worked):

1. **App-level reset:**  
   - Logged out from Tailscale app.
   - Cleared app data & cache from Android settings.
   - Uninstalled the app completely.

2. **Admin-side cleanup:**  
   - Removed the device from Tailscale web admin (waited several minutes before re-login).
   - Refreshed and ensured the device no longer appears (even grayed out).

3. **Full “clean” reinstall attempt:**  
   - Rebooted the phone.
   - Reinstalled Tailscale from Google Play Store.
   - Logged in from scratch (no password manager, no autofill, no browser history).

4. **Network tests:**  
   - Tried on both WiFi and mobile data
   - Used default system DNS (no NextDNS/AdGuard/other custom DNS).

What i noticed also: sometimes despite the error in admin consolle (web gui) phone is able to connect LAN but no dns is availabe. Forcing using phone dns it seems to work (at least in 1/2 tests).

Every time, device appears for a few seconds in Tailscale admin, then “duplicate node key” pops up and device goes offline.
No “key clone” or device image has ever been made.

My test started with an updated Android 15 Samsung Flip 6 never used with Tailscale before. 

On top of this i also tried with a brand new Pixel 9, Android  never used with Tailscale before and issue is exactly the same.

I also tried same process on an iPhone (iOS 18.5) — works instantly, never gets “duplicate node key”.
Same as for Windows 11 24H2  and Mac OSX 15.5 

At this point, It appears to be a serious bug in the Android app (or backend), not related to user error, device clone or restore.

I gave up for now, on my Android devices.
